# Armor with AP regeneration: What exactly does that do?

![Armor with AP regeneration: What exactly does that do?](/uploads/34_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## **AP (Action Points)** are important for everything in Fallout 76. e.g. the duration of VATS use, the duration of sprinting, duration of jetpack use, etc.

Our Nuka Knights Scientist Peter Rädle has carried out and recorded several interesting tests. To do this, he compared how the times for full AP regeneration affect different numbers of AP armor pieces and perks.

By **AP armor pieces**, we mean armor with the **2. legendary perk "Accelerates the regeneration of your action points"**. Our main perk is Unyielding, but that is not crucial for the results.

Point zero is full AP regeneration without AP armor with AP acceleration and without the Action Boy perk at 13 seconds. From here you can now improve the regeneration times.

(Without any perk or armor, this time is even 16.6 seconds)

Based on the numbers and graphics, you can clearly see that the first 1-3 pieces of armor with AP acceleration bring significant time advantages. From the 4th part onwards the differences become smaller and there is hardly any advantage in the game. Using “Action Boy” as an additional boost also brings the most without armor with AP acceleration.

## CONCLUSION

Our interpretation from these tests gives us the result that **3 pieces of armor with AP acceleration without the "Action Boy" perk is the most sensible setup** for optimal cost-benefit with **4 sec AP regeneration**. The other 2 pieces of armor can be used more sensibly, for example with poison resistance or something like strength/intelligence +1.

Thank you Peter Rädle for the tests.
